title: The Gaussian hard-sphere fluctuation field on regular Boltzmann intervals
exact_target: For the source-conditioned grand-canonical hard-sphere gas in the three-dimensional Boltzmann–Grad regime, assuming a uniformly Gaussian-bounded regular kinetic solution on [0,T], do all finite collections of centered empirical-field smooth-test values converge jointly to the Gaussian field solving the linearized Boltzmann equation with white-in-time collision noise? Require Poisson initial covariance integral $f_0$ phi psi, independent initial field and noise, and the source collision covariance $integral_0^(min(t,s))$ $C_r(\phi ,\psi )dr$.
